children: Readers of The Wall Street Journal are big fans of architecture and design, but they've also proved to be pretty big history buffs, too.

We started our new "Historic Homes" series to bring our readers inside some of the oldest and most historically significant properties in the U.S. We've toured estates that predate the Civil War, and even the American Revolution.
Test your knowledge of our new series with our quiz, and be sure to share with all the history lovers and real-estate fans in your life.
